subject: Re: BrightCart operational validation for renewal & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Simon Lee <simon@brightcart.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priya Gupta <pgupta@brightcart.com>
Cc: BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Operational validation for renewal & uplift

Neha —

Thanks for the call this morning. As we discussed, BrightCart is approaching our annual renewal window and evaluating a capacity uplift (roughly +30% token volume) alongside a potential 12–18 month term extension. We have two major asks from the platform team before we move forward:

1) A short, runbooked operational test that demonstrates sustained throughput with our peak request profile (p95 seq len ~380).
2) Clarity on commercial terms for committed capacity (monthly commit + overage pricing) and any conditional SLA credits for latency regressions.

We are running a parallel evaluation with another vendor who has offered a cheaper base price but shared limited SLO guarantees — reliability matters more to us. Can you confirm you can run a 12-hour sustained throughput test next week and share the test plan and a draft term sheet we can review with procurement?

Best,
Simon
Simon Lee
Head of Platform Engineering
BrightCart Inc
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Lee <simon@brightcart.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <pgupta@brightcart.com>, Monic Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational validation for renewal & uplift

Simon —

Really appreciate the clarity. We can absolutely run a 12-hour sustained throughput validation aligned to the profile you described. Proposed plan (high level):

- Phase 1 (Prep, 1 business day): share workload spec + lightweight synthetic traces.
- Phase 2 (Benchmark run, 12 hours): sustained p95 and error/latency monitoring, with KV cache warmed.
- Phase 3 (Readout & artifacts): CSV logs, token-level cost summary, and a short Ops runbook you can hand off to your SREs.

I'm attaching the test plan: redwood_capacity_test_plan_v1.xlsx (contains inputs we need from you and our metrics checklist). Monica (CC) will own end-to-end ops during the run and Ben will lead the benchmark execution.

For commercials, I'll loop in our renewal lead for a draft uplift term sheet and a plan for conditional SLA credits if latency exceeds agreed SLOs during the validation window. Targeting next Wednesday for the run — 6/17 — unless you prefer earlier.

Next steps: could you share a 48-hour sample of production request traces or confirm we can replay your synthetic trace? Also please confirm procurement contact for the term sheet.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128
From: Priya Gupta <pgupta@brightcart.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Simon Lee <simon@brightcart.com>
Cc: BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational validation for renewal & uplift

Neha —

We can provide a 48-hour sample trace (anonymized) and a replay endpoint for the synthetic workload. Procurement contact is procurement@brightcart.com (I included them here). A few constraints from our security/compliance team: we need to confirm data handling during the test (no persistent logs outside ephemeral test storage) and a SOC2 attestation for the environment you run the benchmark in.

I'll upload the traces to the Drive link you provided once I have confirmation on the replay details.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Gupta
Director, Infrastructure
BrightCart Inc
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Operational validation for renewal & uplift

Neha / Ben / Monica —

Forwarding Simon's note and Priya's constraints. Quick internal gameplan and commercial proposal I recommend:

- Offer: 12-month committed uplift for +30% baseline capacity with a stepped discount (month 1–3: 10% off on committed blocks; month 4–12: 15% off) if they sign a 12-month commit within 14 days of successful validation.
- SLA carve-out: conditional credit up to 20% of monthly invoice if p95 latency on the agreed endpoint exceeds 850ms for >3% of requests over a rolling week during the term.
- Proof deliverables: raw CSV logs, token-level cost estimate, and a short ops runbook.

Ben — can you confirm the hardware profile you'd want for the benchmark and whether we should include a quantized variant to show cost/latency tradeoffs? Monica, please prepare the runbook template and an artifact checklist (in the Drive).

I'll draft a short uplift term sheet (attached: draft_uplift_term_sheet.pdf) for procurement to review and include a DocuSign envelope link for signature once they sign off. We should avoid over-indexing on price in the readout; emphasize reliability and billing predictability.

- Marissa
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Operational validation for renewal & uplift

Marissa / team —

I can run the benchmark on our dedicated cluster that matches BrightCart's workload class (A100-equivalent nodes with KV cache warmed). Notes:

- Request: provide anonymized 48-hour trace or confirm replay endpoint by EOD 6/15 so we can generate the synthetic pump.
- I'll use a two-pass test: first 4h warmup (cache + cold start patterns), then 12h sustained profile. We'll collect per-token latency histograms and GPU utilization.
- Attachment: benchmark_script_v3.sh (instrumented runner) — Simon, can you provision a short-lived API key scoped to the replay dataset and a whitelist CIDR for the run?

If quantized variant is desired we can run the second pass with 4-bit quant to show cost delta; that will add ~2 hours to the run.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Simon Lee <simon@brightcart.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Gupta <pgupta@brightcart.com>, BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational validation for renewal & uplift

Neha / Marissa / Ben —

All sounds good, thank you. We'll upload the anonymized trace to the Drive link by EOD 6/14 and open a short-lived API key for the replay endpoint. Procurement has visibility on the draft term sheet — they'll come back with standard redlines but expect the pricing/commit model to be the main negotiation lever.

Small note: the other vendor is offering ~12% lower committed pricing but cannot provide the same SLA guarantees or the trial artifacts (they won't provide token-level logs). Our infra team prioritized reliability last quarter so we are leaning towards the partner that can demonstrate operational parity. If the validation shows you can reliably sustain our profile, procurement will likely accept a modest premium for the SLA.

Let's lock 6/17 for the test. Please send an exact start time and final runbook by Monday morning so we can get internal approvals.

—Simon
